newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo gold futures end narrowly mixed, off lows.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo gold futures end narrowly mixed, off lows.

text.p: Yen-based Tokyo gold futures ended narrowly mixed on Wednesday but off early lows after narrow-range trade as firmer prices in New York overnight were offset by the yen's stronger tendency, traders said.
Gold prices ranged from one yen per gram lower to one yen firmer, with the most active benchmark October ending flat at 1,331 yen.
Bullion was a tad firmer. It was quoted at $369.00/30 per ounce at the Tokyo close, having rebounded from early lows of $368.25/55 and from $368.40/80 in New York on Tuesday.
